title: Daughter, father 60: face droopy since yesterday, ear pain, otherwise fine

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: 2041 Balboa Street. It's my dad, he's 60.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Tell me exactly what happened.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The right side of his face is droopy. He can't close his right eye all the way, and his ear hurts.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Since yesterday. He was fine yesterday morning, then last night his face started looking off.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Can he lift both arms and talk normally?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, his arms are fine and he's talking fine, he's walking around normally.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, nothing else. Just the face and the ear.

turns.speaker: dispatcher
turns.text: Okay. Help is on the way. Stay with him.
